career_ladder.note: Apprentice Development Officers (ADOs) in the Life Insurance Corporation of India belong to Class II cadre, responsible for sponsoring, recruiting, training, and managing Life Insurance Agents and mobilizing insurance business within their allotted territories. On successful completion of apprenticeship and probation, candidates are confirmed as regular Development Officers, with a career path leading into Class I Branch and Divisional marketing management cadres.

LIC Staff Regulations — Development Officers (Class II) Terms of Service

steps.designation: Assistant Branch Manager (Sales) — Class I Officer
steps.years: approx. 6-10 yrs (based on business appraisal and performance quota)

steps.designation: Marketing Manager (Divisional Office) / Senior Divisional Manager

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Apprentice Development Officers is conducted through a three-stage process: Phase I Preliminary Examination (Objective, 100 marks), Phase II Main Examination (Objective, 160 marks, 120 minutes), followed by Phase III Interview and Pre-recruitment Medical Examination. In Preliminary Examination, the English Language test is qualifying only and its score is not counted for shortlisting ranking. In the Main Examination, a negative marking deduction of 1/4th (0.25) mark applies for every incorrect response.

financial_package.note: During apprenticeship, candidates receive a fixed stipend equal to the minimum basic pay and DA applicable to Development Officers (approx. ₹51,500/month). On appointment as Probationary Development Officer, basic pay starts at ₹35,650 per month in the scale of ₹35,650 - 2,200(2) - 40,050 - 2,595(2) - 45,240 - 2,645(17) - 90,205 (under subsequent wage revision). Confirmed Development Officers are also eligible for substantial annual performance incentives based on business procurement.
financial_package.pay_source_label: LIC of India — Recruitment of ADO Notification 2023 (Stipend & Emoluments)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on post-confirmation basic pay of ₹35,650 plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (10% to 7% by city category), and City Compensatory Allowance; excludes performance-linked incentive bonuses which vary based on agency procurement targets.
official_perks: Fixed stipend of approx. ₹51,500/month during apprenticeship period
Performance-linked incentive bonus based on insurance business mobilization
Comprehensive medical insurance cover / Group Mediclaim for self and family
Defined contribution pension benefits under LIC Pension Rules and Gratuity
Concessional vehicle advance, mobile reimbursement, and complimentary insurance covers

competition_benchmarks.note: LIC recruits Apprentice Development Officers across 8 Zonal offices (Central, Eastern, East Central, Northern, North Central, Southern, South Central, and Western) for Open Market, Agents, and Employee categories. In the 2023 pan-India recruitment, a total of 9,394 vacancies were notified across zones.
